name: Minlaton Harry Butler Red Devil Memorial
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Minlaton See lists the restored Red Devil Bristol monoplane in a town-centre building, free; first over-water flight in the southern hemisphere (history, concrete exhibit).
objection: One counted source, a 15-30 minute stop, and it is a memorial by name; could be a minor memorial or fail as a roadside look.

name: Corny Point Lighthouse
reason: Rule 1/2: yorkepeninsula.com.au names Corny Point (and Wikivoyage mentions the lighthouse, link dead); a lighthouse on a wild south-west coast is a typical second-tier stop.
objection: Only the township appears on the site, not the lighthouse itself; page views 222, the lighthouse is mostly seen from outside; thin evidence.

name: Hardwicke Bay
reason: Rule 1/3: a coastal holiday settlement listed only as a township; no source names anything to see or do beyond the town.
objection: The township page exists on the tourism site and the beach is sandy; but no named draw.

name: Chinamans Hat Island
reason: Rule 1/2: no counted source (re-looked at Wikivoyage Yorke pages and parks.sa.gov.au: not named); offshore rock island with no public landing.
objection: Wikipedia has 911 views; but nobody visits it and no visitor source names it.

name: Gleesons Landing
reason: Rule 3: a minor Walk the Yorke access landing; no source describes anything to see or do, no coordinates.
objection: The trail brand is real and the landing is open; but it is part of the Walk the Yorke trail rather than a draw.

name: Point Souttar
reason: Rule 1/3: a coastal locality listed among towns on the tourism site; no source names a thing to see or do.
objection: Could be a quiet beach stop; unsupported.

name: Ardrossan Jetty
reason: Rule 3: a small town jetty, no guide names it as a stop; fishing platform seen in passing (duplicate-quality with a dozen YP jetties).
objection: Historic jetties are a Yorke Peninsula theme (parks.sa.gov.au mentions fishing off historic jetties).

name: Ardrossan Heritage Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: a community heritage museum named on yorkepeninsula.com.au; open to the public.
objection: One source only, 0 views, small-town volunteer museum with limited hours; arguably a local venue.

name: Ardrossan Murals and Mosaics
reason: Rule 3: a set of town murals and mosaics, scattered street art; no guide singles out a place to go, minor.
objection: Mural trails are a recognised small-town attraction and free.

name: Port Vincent Pontoon
reason: Rule 3: a swimming pontoon listed by Wikivoyage with no description; a local swim spot, not a distinct draw.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it as the only See item, so it is a counted source.

name: Port Vincent Putt Putt
reason: Rule 2: a mini golf course is a commercial amusement, not a place a guide singles out.
objection: Family fun listing on the tourism site.

name: Stansbury Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: two counted sources (Wikivoyage See and yorkepeninsula.com.au); a volunteer local museum, open Wed and Sun 2-4pm.
objection: Short opening hours, small museum, local history; not worth a trip.

name: Stansbury Seaside Markets
reason: Rule 4: a periodic seaside market (weekly/seasonal), not a permanent venue.
objection: Wikivoyage lists it under Do.

name: Stansbury Foreshore Murals
reason: Rule 3: foreshore murals, minor public art with no guide naming a stop.
objection: Free and open.

name: Harbour Masters Park Stansbury
reason: Rule 3: a small foreshore park in town; ordinary local park, no source names a thing to do.
objection: Foreshore park may be a nice picnic stop.

name: Stansbury Jetty
reason: Rule 3: a town jetty; no source names anything to see or do beyond fishing; duplicate-quality with other YP jetties.
objection: Jetty fishing is a YP draw.

name: Edithburgh Museum
reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Edithburgh See names it (Sat Sun 2-4pm, adults $3); open to the public.
objection: One counted source, small hours, local history museum.

name: Sultana Point
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Edithburgh Do names it as the swimming beach south of town with white sand and the end of the mosaic walking trail; a second-tier beach stop (COVERAGE.md).
objection: Only one counted source and beach is small; page views 242.

name: Edithburgh Tidal Pool
reason: Rule 1/2: two counted sources (Wikivoyage Edithburgh Do and yorkepeninsula.com.au); a tidal sea-water swimming pool set into the cliff, with change rooms, free and always open.
objection: Local swimming pool; a tidal pool is a modest draw, a half hour swim.

name: Edithburgh Jetty
reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names Edithburgh Jetty as a popular scuba and snorkel venue (and in its Yorke regional listing with coordinates).
objection: Divers only in practice; a jetty is not a distinct sight for general visitors; duplicate of other YP jetties.

name: Troubridge Island
reason: Rule 1/2: three counted sources including parks.sa.gov.au (Troubridge Island Conservation Park) and Wikivoyage Edithburgh: the 1855 cast-iron lighthouse and keepers cottage, visited by boat from Edithburgh (island is the spot, not the boat).
objection: Permit and boat access needed; most visitors will not go; seabird sanctuary with restricted access.

name: Troubridge Hill Lighthouse
reason: Rule 1/2: no counted source (Wikivoyage only mentions it in passing as a working light, not the island one); a working lighthouse with no named visit.
objection: Lighthouses are a recognised draw; but nothing says it is open.

name: Wool Bay Jetty and Lime Kilns
reason: Rule 1/2: yorkepeninsula.com.au lists Wool Bay as a town; the historic jetty and lime kilns are a free heritage stop on the coast road.
objection: Only the town name is in the source I could open, not the kilns specifically; a ten-minute look.

name: Coobowie Aquatic Reserve
reason: Rule 1: no counted source (re-looked); a marine aquatic reserve with no visitor facility named.
objection: Aquatic reserves can be snorkel spots; nothing says so here.

name: Yorketown Pink Lakes

objection: Colour is not there whenever you arrive, the entry is a generic group of lakes (duplicate of Salt Lake Trail), no named access point.

name: Wattle Point Wind Farm
